name: Cloud Dragon, riding (version B)
note: Version 2. One posed model: the cloud is one unbroken piece, like the drawing: it starts as his dragon afro, runs down behind his left shoulder, across behind his legs, becomes the cloud he stands on, and ends in a curled tail. Claude checked all three views against the drawing (one cloud, same crouch in every view, skin tone, hearts, belt, boots). From behind, the cloud drapes across his back.
